Base: egui_commonmark 0.22.0, copied from the Cargo.lock-pinned crates.io source.
Upstream: https://github.com/lampsitter/egui_commonmark
Licenses: LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE, retained without modification.

MDcard patch: src/parsers/pulldown.rs bounds table column widths to the
available preview width. Each row uses top-aligned wrapping child UIs and
the maximum measured cell height from the current frame. Row backgrounds
are painted from those measurements before advancing to the next row.
This avoids egui Grid's cached heights and vertical centering pushing
wrapped text outside its row after resizing or mixing inline formatting.
This retains the upstream Markdown events, links, math callbacks, and table
rendering while allowing cells to reflow when a Read/Split pane is resized.
No Markdown source or export pipeline is rewritten.

Regression: src/main.rs::preview_layout_tests::table_cells_reflow_in_full_read_and_split_layouts
Regression: src/main.rs::preview_layout_tests::wrapped_table_rows_contain_text_and_do_not_overlap

2026-10-27: geometry/asset preview images use independent bounded wait/error
cards with a real minimum height, 15-second timeout and per-image retry.
The 64-URI history evicts corresponding egui byte/image/texture loader data
via Context::forget_image. Non-asset viewer paths retain the backend widget.

2026-10-28: PaintedText carries semantic TableRow intervals and measured row
geometry for Split synchronization. The real Label layout is retained for a
clipped first cell only while its row intersects the viewport; layout-only
observations are distinct from painted shapes. Selection and elided tooltips
use the native egui Label behavior. Quoted and alert tables share table().
Terminal rows expose their own lower extent. Application geometry validates
both endpoints and source-line adjacency against the current source index,
rejecting generated page headers and discontinuous endpoint projections.
Regressions: reading_geometry::tests::semantic_table_*,
large_document::tests::semantic_table_geometry_rejects_repeated_page_headers_and_keeps_terminal_body_rows,
split_scroll_tests::table_tall_terminal_row_uses_current_layout_extent_bidirectionally.
